text: Patrick McGee @PatrickMcGee_ Apple hardware chief Johny Srouji would be an incredible choice to lead @nvidia -- and I believe he'd accept it. He's hit the ceiling at Apple and won't ever be CEO ; obviously competent; ambitious as hell; has long wanted chip designs to dictate Apple product launches/timelines. Jesse Cohen @JesseCohenInv Nov 12 One person being considered for the top job (NVDA CEO) is Apple hardware chief Johny Srouji, who was among the executives considered for Intel CEO in 2019, according to another person familiar with the matter. - Semafor
